title: As the Iran war drags on, 'shell-shocked' CEOs may soon break their silence on Trump | Fortune
summary: Oil prices surge due to potential conflict in the Middle East, impacting global markets and U.S. taxpayers. Protests against government policies and concerns over AI implementation in workplaces are also highlighted.
